svg.title: A derivative predicts the next small step
svg.desc: A parabola and its tangent at t=2. They meet with equal slope but differ away from the contact point. The tangent captures the value and first derivative. Curvature enters at the next order; the same hierarchy will appear in a local expansion of the metric.

g.text: 01 / A DERIVATIVE PREDICTS THE NEXT SMALL STEP

svg.aria-label: At t = 2, the slope of x = t² is 4.

g.text: The line matches value and slope.
The curve reveals the next-order change.
